title: Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide Europe's largest asset manager raised its Strategy holding to 1.9 million shares in the third quarter, a 13F shows, even as MSTR has since fallen about 18% from quarter-end. This post Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
